name: playwright-cli
description: Automate browser interactions, test web pages, and work with Playwright tests. Requires Node.js. Claude in Chrome extension is optional but recommended for best experience.

node.description: Node.js must be installed to run playwright-cli

npm.description: npm comes with Node.js, used to install playwright-cli

browser.description: Chrome browser (optional but recommended for --extension mode)

constraints.plan: This skill works on all plans, but some advanced features may have rate limits on Free plan. Paid plans recommended for heavy usage.
